verses.text: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
lines: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up.
All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

verses.text: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
lines: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long,
for they are many who fight proudly against me.

verses.text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
lines: When I am afraid,
I will put my trust in you.

verses.text: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
lines: In God, I praise his word.
In God, I put my trust.
I will not be afraid.
What can flesh do to me?

verses.text: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
lines: All day long they twist my words.
All their thoughts are against me for evil.

verses.text: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
lines: They conspire and lurk,
watching my steps.
They are eager to take my life.

verses.text: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
lines: Shall they escape by iniquity?
In anger cast down the peoples, God.

verses.text: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
lines: You count my wanderings.
You put my tears into your container.
Aren’t they in your book?

verses.text: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
lines: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call.
I know this: that God is for me.

verses.text: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.
lines: In God, I will praise his word.
In Yahweh, I will praise his word.

verses.text: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
lines: I have put my trust in God.
I will not be afraid.
What can man do to me?

verses.text: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
lines: Your vows are on me, God.
I will give thank offerings to you.

verses.text: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
lines: For you have delivered my soul from death,
and prevented my feet from falling,
that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
